Initial release of innotech-polymarket-api skill.

- Provides a comprehensive guide to connecting and accessing Polymarket API data.
- Covers API endpoints, authentication, market search/filtering, and accessing market/order book/trade data.
- Explains real-time data access via WebSocket and Socket.IO, with polling as a fallback.
- Includes sample Python code snippets for common tasks.
- Details market, price, and order book data structures.
- Spells out best practices for data polling and API usage.
